Un desastre el servicio del martes  24 de sepriembre 13.30 hs. Estuve 15 minutos parado. Los ñlayeros pasaban y ni aiuqoera saludaban. Pregunte y estaba. En cambio de turno. Fui al shop mientras esperaba y no habia madie. Volvi y nadie me atendii. Me subi y me fui el playero me miraba como este loco. Un desaatre la peor atencion que recibi en un local ypf

(Translated by Google)
The service on Tuesday, September 24th at 1:30 PM was a disaster. I stood there for 15 minutes. The attendants walked by without even saying hello. I asked, and they said they were changing shifts. I went to the shop while I waited, and there was nobody there. I went back, and nobody helped me. I got in my car and left. The attendant was looking at me like I was crazy. A disaster, the worst service I've ever received at a YPF station.
